transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been having these times after my evening class where I stop for food, and it kind of gets away from me. I’ll eat a full fast-food meal, then get candy from a vending machine, and then when I get home I’ll still eat more snacks. It feels like I’m trying to make up for not eating much during the day, I guess.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a lot of food?

Yeah… I do. Once I start on the snacks, I keep telling myself to just close the bag and go to bed, but I don’t. My hands just keep going back for more, and afterward I feel embarrassed and kind of sick of myself.
Do you ever try to make up for the extra calories you consumed by doing something like exercising or skipping meals the next day?

Yeah… a few times I have. Not really exercising, but after those late-night eating spells I’ve gone to the bathroom and made myself throw up. I get scared that all that food is going to show on me, and I panic.
How often do these late-night eating spells happen?
It’s been going on for about three months now. Usually it’s at least one night a week after class where I overeat like that, and then I make myself throw up afterward.
Do you usually feel stressed, anxious, or upset before these late-night eating spells happen?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear pattern like that. Sometimes I’m just tired or it’s late and I start eating, but I can’t say I’m always stressed or anxious beforehand.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah. I don’t like admitting it, but yes. If I check the scale and it’s even up a pound the next morning, my stomach just drops. I start worrying people in class are going to look at me like I’m some sloppy old guy who let himself go.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?
Usually about once a week. For the past three months or so, there’s been at least one night after class where I eat too much and then make myself throw up afterward.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a lot of food like that without making yourself throw up afterward?

Yeah, that happens. After my evening class, I’ll stop for food and it can turn into a full fast-food meal, then candy from the vending machine, and when I get home I might keep going with snacks. It feels like I’m making up for the whole day.
Do you feel like you're losing control when you're eating all that food after class?

Yeah, I do. Once I start on the snacks, I’ll tell myself, “Just close the bag and go to bed,” but I don’t. I just keep reaching for more, and then afterward I feel embarrassed and kind of sick with myself.
How often do you have episodes where you eat a lot of food like that without making yourself throw up afterward?

It’s not every day, but it happens sometimes after my evening class. I’ll stop for food and it turns into a full fast-food meal, then maybe candy from the vending machine, and when I get home I keep eating snacks. It feels like I’m making up for not eating much earlier in the day.
How often do you have episodes where you eat a lot of food and don't make yourself throw up afterward?
I’m not really sure exactly. It’s not something I’ve been keeping count of. It happens sometimes, but I couldn’t give you a solid number.
How many times a month would you say you have episodes where you eat a lot of food and don't make yourself throw up afterward?

Maybe a few times a month. It’s usually after my evening class—I'll stop for fast food, then maybe get candy from the vending machine, and when I get home I keep eating snacks. It feels like I’m trying to make up for the whole day.
Do episodes where you eat a lot of food without making yourself throw up happen more often than episodes where you do make yourself throw up?

Yes, I’d say the ones where I don’t throw up happen more often. But a few times after those late-night eating spells, I have gone to the bathroom and made myself throw up because I got scared all that food was going to show on me.
How many times a week do you have episodes where you eat a lot of food and don't make yourself throw up afterward?
Usually about once a week, maybe sometimes twice. It’s mostly after my evening class, when I stop for fast food and then it kind of carries on with candy or snacks at home.
How many times a week do you make yourself throw up after eating a lot of food?
Not every week. Maybe a few times total after those late-night eating times, when I got scared the food was going to show on me. Then I went to the bathroom and made myself throw up.
How many times a month do you make yourself throw up after eating?
Maybe not even every month… it’s only been a few times after those late-night eating spells. When I get scared that all the food is going to show on me, I’ve gone and made myself throw up.
How many times have you made yourself throw up in the past month?

In the past month, I think it’s been a few times. It was after those late-night eating spells, when I panicked that it was all going to show on me, and I went to the bathroom and made myself throw up.
Does making yourself throw up happen every time you have one of these late-night eating spells?
No, not every time. It’s only happened a few times after those late-night eating spells, when I got scared the food was going to show on me and I went to the bathroom to make myself throw up.
How many times have you made yourself throw up after eating in the past three months?
Over the past three months… I’d say usually about once a week. It tends to happen after class at night, when I overeat like that, and then I make myself throw up afterward.
How often do you make yourself throw up after one of these eating episodes?
Usually about once a week. For the past three months or so, there’s been at least one night each week after class where I overeat, and then I end up making myself throw up afterward.
